serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
…
This music again…
I want to kill myself.
I would do anything to make it stop. 
This is torture, actual torture. I watched some 5 minute video about psychological warfare. There was this Operation Nifty something. Our great army used loud noises to psychically destroy some latino guy. Worst thing about it? It worked and the dude surrendered.
So yeah, my neighbor wants me to kick the bucket. At least it seems like it. 
I feel tired… I’m having trouble sleeping and I can’t focus. This sucks.
